tax.text: He said he would cut taxes as part of a plan to lower costs and reduce federal spending.
tax.quote: I will fight for legislation to cut wasteful spending - including codifying DOGE recommendations - reduce taxes and regulations, protect Social Security and Medicare, expand affordable health care access, and support small business job creation in South Florida.

debt.text: He said he opposes cutting Social Security or Medicare and would address waste and fraud in those programs.
debt.quote: No creo en recortar la Seguridad Social ni Medicare. Creo que, si examinamos el despilfarro, el fraude y el abuso, sería un momento magnífico para empezar.

housing.text: He proposed reducing federal red tape and regulations to speed housing processes, while working with local authorities.
housing.quote: Reduciendo la burocracia del gobierno federal. Hay muchísimas regulaciones y trámites burocráticos asociados a esto, y facilitar eso para permitir procesos más rápidos trabajando, por supuesto, con las autoridades locales, porque también es un tema muy local.

schools.text: He said education should be handled mainly at the state and local levels and that he supports school choice.
schools.quote: For K-12 and higher ed, we should reduce bureaucracy, promote school choice, accountability, and workforce readiness while avoiding federal overreach into curricula or operations.

safety.text: He said he would support bills to back law enforcement and combat violent crime.
safety.quote: I will also support bills to secure the border, back law enforcement, combat violent crime, prioritize American citizens, and protect election integrity via the SAVE Act.

immigration.text: He supports stricter border enforcement while also advocating more efficient legal immigration pathways.
immigration.quote: I strongly support comprehensive reforms that prioritize border security as a non-negotiable foundation, followed by streamlining our legal immigration system. Secure borders prevent illegal crossings, drug trafficking, and threats to public safety - policies like ending catch and release, reinstating Remain in Mexico, and enhancing enforcement have proven effective. Simultaneously, we must reduce bureaucratic red tape in legal pathways.

abortion.text: In an interview, he described himself as firmly pro-life.
abortion.quote: ¿Y cuál es su posición sobre el aborto? Soy firmemente provida.

energy.text: He said he favors reducing fuel and electricity costs and developing the country's energy potential.
energy.quote: Y por supuesto, también reduciendo el coste del combustible y de la electricidad. Creo firmemente que Estados Unidos tiene un enorme potencial energético.

voting.text: He supports the SAVE Act's citizenship-proof requirement as an election-integrity measure.
voting.quote: Only U.S. citizens should vote, and requiring proof of citizenship (via the SAVE Act) is a common-sense safeguard, not a barrier.

wages.text: He supports wages that keep pace with local living costs and workers’ right to organize and negotiate.
wages.quote: Support fair wages that keep pace with the actual cost of living in South Florida.

debt.text: He says he would defend Social Security and Medicare from cuts.
debt.quote: Protect Social Security, Medicare, and the earned benefits working people paid into their whole lives.

housing.text: He supports expanding affordable housing so more families can find a home they can afford.
housing.quote: Expand affordable housing so working families, seniors, and young people can find a home they can actually afford.

schools.text: He proposes raising public-school funding and teacher salaries.
schools.quote: Raise public-school funding so classrooms have the resources, materials, and support they need.

immigration.text: He supports border security and deportation for people who commit crimes, alongside legal pathways and family reunification.
immigration.quote: Dr. Maxime believes we can have both security and compassion — and that we should stop pretending we have to choose:

tax.text: She called for a fair tax system that provides adequate federal funding for services and infrastructure.
tax.quote: We need a fair taxation system that supports a growing economy, small business creation, and American families – while ensuring our federal government has adequate funding to support services and infrastructure that make our country work.

wages.text: She cosponsored legislation to raise the federal minimum wage and has called for higher wages and workplace protections.
wages.quote: I have cosponsored legislation to raise the federal minimum wage and tipped minimum wage to 15 dollars by 2020.

trade.text: She called for rolling back tariffs and advancing other trade policies.
trade.quote: Roll back Trump’s tariffs and advance smarter, durable trade policies.

debt.text: She has repeatedly said she will defend Social Security and Medicare benefits against cuts.
debt.quote: And I will fiercely protect health care, including Social Security and Medicare programs that millions of Americans count on

housing.text: She proposed updating zoning and permitting laws to build four million homes over the next decade.
housing.quote: Cut red tape and update permitting and zoning laws to build four million new homes in the next decade.

schools.text: She called for federal investment in public K-12 schools and resources for district teachers and students.
schools.quote: Now more than ever, we must commit to our national education system by investing in our public K-12 schools.

immigration.text: She supports pathways to citizenship and protections for DREAMers, refugees, and other immigrants.
immigration.quote: This includes providing a pathway to citizenship, fair treatment under the law, and extending protections for DREAMers, Temporary Protected Status holders, and refugees.

guns.text: She supports universal background checks and other gun-violence-prevention measures.
guns.quote: laws, like universal background checks, that would help prevent these recurring tragedies.

abortion.text: She has repeatedly supported abortion rights and cosponsored legislation establishing federal protections for abortion access.
abortion.quote: Throughout my career, I have been unwavering in my support for abortion rights. Such basic, personal rights can never be compromised.

health.text: She backed expanding ACA coverage and Medicaid access and called to fully fund Medicaid and strengthen Medicare.
health.quote: Fully fund Medicaid and strengthen Medicare’s guaranteed benefits.

energy.text: She supports a rapid transition to renewable energy and says greenhouse gas emissions must be dramatically reduced.
energy.quote: I believe it is critical that we use smart, forward-thinking energy policy to address the climate crisis and prevent the worst consequences of climate change by dramatically reducing our emissions of greenhouse gases.

voting.text: She opposed restrictions on voter registration and said eligible voters should be able to vote without barriers.
voting.quote: We must keep fighting to ensure that all citizens who are eligible to vote can vote, and work to tear down barriers like those created by this onerous state law.
